column3: You found it? Impressive.{page_break}Keep looking. There may\nbe more like it.{end_wait}
No luck. Our Psynergy\nisn't strong enough to\nmove that stump.{end_wait}
That glittering dust on\nthe ground. What is it?{end_wait}
Do you know what those\nfields used to be?{end_wait}
Back! It's happening\nagain!{end_wait}
He's as lost as we are{pause_20_skippable},\nbut he says he'll help.{end_wait}
You're right,\n{actor_name:1}. There's nothing\nmore we can do.{end_wait}
Thank goodness,\n{actor_name:1}.{pause_20_skippable} I thought you'd\nabandoned Kolima.{end_wait}

Mercury Lighthouse's
healing waters might
save Tret...{page_break}But that fountain ran
dry long ago.{end_wait}
I hold Tret's heart!\nI won't let you touch\nhim!{end_wait}
What are you doing,\n{actor_name:1}?! This is no time\nto fool around!{end_wait}
That should do it.{pause_20_skippable}\nKolima is cursed no\nmore.{end_wait}
Yes, I was angry. You\nlaid waste to my forest.{page_break}You even raised your\naxes against me!{end_wait}
I owe you a debt. You\nsaved Kolima, the forest,\nand me.{end_wait}
With this power, no axe\nwill ever touch me again.{page_break}Go in peace. You have\nnothing to fear.{end_wait}
Kolima's forest lives\nagain, thanks to you.{page_break}We will guard it from\nnow on.{end_wait}
I can't stop you. But be\ncareful beyond the river.{end_wait}

It must be terrible
beyond the river...{page_break}I worry about you and
your friends,
{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
Leave, before this forest\nis destroyed...{end_wait}
If I could speak, I'd\nwarn them. This is\nKolima... or it was.{end_wait}
How could anyone turn a\ngirl like me into a tree?{page_break}...I do make a rather\nlovely tree, though.{end_wait}
This is a dream. It has\nto be a dream.{end_wait}
Not being able to move\nis worse than I thought.{end_wait}

I'm old. I've lived a
full life. Being a tree
doesn't trouble me.{page_break}It's the children I
pity. They were turned
too.{end_wait}
The sacred tree's curse!\nWhy did they try to cut\ndown Tret?{end_wait}
If I can't move, Mom\ncan't make me go to bed.{page_break}...I want my mom.{end_wait}
Why are they staring?\nThey look so young...{page_break}They won't survive Tret.{end_wait}
Soon all of Kolima will\nbe forest. Nothing else.{end_wait}
Maybe this is payment\nfor all the trees we cut.{page_break}We were only doing our\njobs. Weren't we?{end_wait}

I used to carve weapons
out of wood. Now I am
wood.{page_break}Life has a cruel sense
of humor.{end_wait}
No! I don't want to be\na tree forever!{end_wait}
Being a tree gives you a\ngreat deal of time to\nthink. Too much.{end_wait}
I turned the moment the\nsparkles fell from the\nsky. It didn't hurt.{end_wait}

We've had too many
strangers lately.{page_break}Are you after the
lighthouse? Mia won't
like that.{end_wait}

People get sick from
hiding indoors all day.{page_break}Keep moving, keep warm.
That's what keeps you
alive here.{end_wait}
There's a sickness in\nImil. It's spreading.{page_break}If you value your life,\nleave now.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4} never rests,\ncaring for the sick.{page_break}I don't want to be\nanother burden to her.{end_wait}
He always exaggerates.\nThis time I'm not sure he\nis.{end_wait}
Who are these people?\nOnly a fool or a fighter\ncrosses to Imil in winter.{end_wait}
Are they headed for the\nlighthouse, too?{page_break}They'll never get in\nwithout {actor_name:4}.{end_wait}
Two groups of travelers\nin this snow. Why?{page_break}The first group already\nheaded off somewhere.{end_wait}
I'm only a student, but\nI can heal you if you\nneed it.{end_wait}
These folk seem all right.\nThey don't look dangerous.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4} said she had a bad\nfeeling about something.{page_break}Could she have meant\nthese people?{end_wait}

{actor_name:4} is a good girl.
She works herself ragged.{page_break}She teaches Megan and
Justin, and no one else
in all this time.{page_break}Her last apprentice
vanished. She doesn't
talk about it.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4}'s clan guarded the\nlighthouse to the east.{page_break}Now only she remains.{end_wait}
